name: Diamond Power Infrastructure Limited
summary: Diamond Power Infrastructure Limited engages in the manufacturing and sale of cables and conductors in India. The company offers low voltage, high voltage, extra high voltage, control, solar, fire survival/resistant, communication, marine and offshore, single and multi core, and instrumentation cables.
